question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

Abundant garbage kept at one place.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words** "Abundant garbage kept at one place" **is: **'Heap of garbage'**
 
• Explanation: **"Heap" **refers to an untidy collection or pile of things, often used to refer to an accumulation of discarded or waste material.
 
• The given group of words describes a pile or large amount of garbage kept at one place which can be best referred to as a "heap of garbage".
 
• **Heap of garbage: **This refers to a pile of waste materials or discarded items.(कचरे का ढेर)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Heap of garbage'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hill of garbage:** Though it can also refer to a large pile of garbage, it's not a commonly used term. It could imply a very large amount of garbage, almost the size of a hill, but it's typically not used in everyday language.(कचरे का पहाड़)
 
• **Lot of garbage: **This refers to a large amount of garbage, but it doesn't necessarily imply that the garbage is kept in one place or pile.(बहुत सारा कचरा)
 
• **Mound of garbage: **This can also refer to a pile or heap of garbage, but the term "heap" is more commonly used. A "mound" generally implies a structured pile, often of earth or stones, and isn't as commonly used for garbage. (कचरे का टीला)
